messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU_POOL_QUEUE_GROWTH triggered for gpu-pool-east-1a (queue length > 1200) · severity: high · Pager: on-call-sre · Please acknowledge. :rotating_light:
jamie (oncall-sre): acked. pulling up metrics now. quick note — traffic spike to embed endpoints?
lee (eng-runtime): I see a sudden 3x ingress for /v1/embeddings from a small set of IPs. autoscaler reports scale_decision=NO_SCALE, reason=quota_check_failure.
jamie (oncall-sre): that explains queue growth. are we hitting global GPU quota or per-pool limit?
lee (eng-runtime): per-pool shard limit. autoscaler tried to request additional nodes but allocation failed at the cloud API due to the limit check in our controller. logs: ```2026-06-12T15:24:07Z controller: request_add_nodes(8) -> denied: pool_quota_exceeded(pool=gpu-pool-east-1a, limit=64)```
kiran (ops): cloud quotas show pool cap at 64 GPUs, current in-use 64. No free capacity in region. We have queued requests in scheduler for 14 jobs waiting.
emma (support): getting customer reports: several production customers see API timeouts and 429 throttles after 30s. Support ticket 78321 opened, customers impacted: 5 mid-market accounts, 2 PLG apps.
sara (customer-success): flagged by CHURN_RISK for two accounts. Need mitigation ASAP and an ETA to share.
jamie (oncall-sre): immediate mitigations options: 1) apply emergency degrade: reject lower-priority requests (non-authenticated / free tier) 2) broadburst to other regions (cross-region routing) 3) request temporary quota bump from cloud console (slow) 4) spin up smaller-quantized model variants to shift load.
mark (eng-lead): prioritize #1 + #4. We can't depend on manual quota bump for SLA. Can we flip promote cached KV prefixes and route embeddings to quantized variants?
lee (eng-runtime): we can hot-route 40% of embedding traffic to q4-emb-small replicas in other pools if we enable model-variant-fallback. That requires a config toggle and a quick rollout. I can push the toggle in 10m.
jamie (oncall-sre): implement flow: (A) enable emergency traffic steering to allow only authenticated/paid customers -> immediately cut 35% of ingress. (B) enable model-variant-fallback for embeddings -> shift additional 40% into q4 variants. (C) monitor queue length and error rate.
jamie (oncall-sre): @deploy-bot please run the routing toggle playbook: ```/run playbooks/emergency/steer-to-paid --channel incidents --reason "gpu-pool saturation"```
deploy-bot: STARTED: playbook playbooks/emergency/steer-to-paid by jamie (oncall-sre). Steps: 1) apply route filter 2) update rate-limiter rules 3) publish notice.
lee (eng-runtime): pushing model-variant-fallback toggle now, will update canary route and then global. patch diff: ```- embeddings: preferred: rtx32 ```
```+ embeddings: fallback_variants: [q4-emb-small, q4-emb-tiny]```
lee (eng-runtime): canary applied to 2 nodes in gpu-pool-east-1b. initial requests show 45ms per-call for q4 vs 30ms for rtx32, accuracy check pass on sanity set.
jamie (oncall-sre): route filter applied — unauthenticated/free-tier traffic now returns 429 with structured explanation and retry-after header. early telemetry: ingress reduced 33% within 90s. queue length went from 1.2k -> 780.
emma (support): posting canned customer message to impacted accounts now. template includes mitigation and CTA to reach CSM. :white_check_mark:
lee (eng-runtime): fallback rollout at 40% completed. scheduler shows 9 pending jobs -> 3 -> now 0 for high-priority. queue length steady at ~220.
jamie (oncall-sre): monitoring: 5xx rate down from 12% -> 1.1% in 8m. latency slightly increased for some customers using fallback.
mark (eng-lead): good. next: request permanent fixes — autoscaler bug that treats quota-check-deny as terminal instead of retrying with smaller batch sizes. Create action item.
kiran (ops): opened cloud support ticket for quota bump as precaution (ticket #CS-9921). ETA unknown.
sara (customer-success): notified two at-risk customers with timeline and mitigation. awaiting replies.
jamie (oncall-sre): preparing handoff. I'll stay for initial post-incident notes. On-call rotation for SRE shifts in 45m; @lee please be second responder for follow-up until we close.
lee (eng-runtime): I'll stay on this thread. I've captured logs and the controller stacktrace. Suspect root cause: autoscaler interprets allocation failure as overcommit and stops further scaling attempts for 10m due to backoff state machine. We'll add a path to try model-variant fallback when pool allocation fails.
jamie (oncall-sre): action items (short): [A] emergency routing playbook applied — keep active until quota/scale resolved. [B] eng-runtime to implement autoscaler retry policy + fallback routing (PR + tests) — assignee: lee, due: 2026-06-14. [C] ops to coordinate quota bump and region capacity report — assignee: kiran, ticket CS-9921. [D] support/CS to outreach impacted customers and log RCA expectation — assignee: emma/sara. [E] postmortem doc scheduled — assignee: jamie, due: 2026-06-16.
mark (eng-lead): also add automated alert to detect rapid quota denial pattern and escalate to pagers earlier.
jamie (oncall-sre): leaving note for handoff: If queue begins growing >500 after 30m, escalate to severity-1 and call on-call infra. Otherwise, monitor and sync in 30m.
emma (support): closing interim support loop: customers updated, PSAT request for account with large traffic.
lee (eng-runtime): pushed minimal fix branch for autoscaler retry logic. will open PR in 1h. logs/traces attached to incident tracker.
jamie (oncall-sre): handoff: @kiran you'll own cloud quota ticket; @lee you'll own engineering fix; I'll own postmortem + timeline. Thanks team, good mitigation work. :pray: 
deploy-bot: COMPLETED: playbooks/emergency/steer-to-paid by jamie. duration: ~6m.
jamie (oncall-sre): handoff complete. leaving channel but reachable.
lee (eng-runtime): acknowledged. I'll post PR link and bench numbers into the postmortem doc.
mark (eng-lead): filing follow-up to review capacity strategy for peak loads and to consider soft-fallback routing as default.
jamie (oncall-sre): closing thread for active mitigation; will reopen if regressions. End of thread.
